mansion_exit_01.text: When he left the mansion, he realized he had nowhere to go. The old town near the windswept harbor was dim and deserted as the snow began to fall. Driven by the chilling air blowing from the river,he started walking aimlessly.

AcrabHall.text: In the Council Hall of the Independent Labor Confederation, an emigration plan was being carefully deliberated.

SarasProject.text: Phase1: Saras transplantation, 12-segment separation and pressure-resistant packing. Phase2: In-transit synchronization and drive system adjustment. Phase3:On-site reassembly of all segments and startup testing. Phase4:Phased operational training starting from shallow waters. Drilling Procedure ROV separation and descent, anchor deployment, vertical shaft excavation and wall hardening, and colloid sampling.

Thornhill1.text: The low, gentle sunlight glinted off the cobblestones, the cathedral dome, and the puddles, bathing the entire city in a soft golden glow. The clatter of iron wheels on stone, the whistles of ships navigating the waterways, and the cries of street vendors mingled together as the morning hum gently enveloped the city.

Acrab.text: Not a beast that devours stars, but a cradle hatching them.

Drop.text: What struck me above all was the stench.The colossus collapsed, and the relay shrieked. It was all to conceal the plan.The ancient calendar was right. To the bottom of the storm. Beneath the comet of Kvaarni.

giant.text: It crawls out from between the rocks to feast on the blood of giants.

Through.text: Through the gaps in the clouds, the trembling stars peer down, while on the distant horizon, purple haze smolders—a grim foreboding of the returning storm. Before the fury of the seven moons swells once more and the tempest consumes this land, the pilgrimage must press on.

FlyingAltar.text: It was called the Flying Altar. Whether it came from the far reaches of space, or had been there all along, remains unknown. The only certainty is that, cold as it was, its wings were waiting to spring to life.

journey.text: I lost track of time long ago. The reason for my journey has faded into memory. Yet one truth remains: I will not turn back.

Mirage.text: Passing under the rock, traveling endlessly, the mirror city will finally greet you when the sea breeze slips between the towers and reaches the cave.

HighTower.text:
A heavy metallic echo pierces the dense fog,
reverberating down the ancient stone corridor.

the silent priest.
mr. hightower.

once a pillar of this realm,
now the master of the key that keeps the dark at bay.

another night.
another quiet patrol into the void.

submarine.text: As I look out through the glass at the silent underwater world unfolding before me, I wait for the lights of our destination—the floating domes—to appear in the distance.

Cattle.text:
Washed ashore from the shattered submersible, he found himself in a pitch-black cavern untouched by the deep-sea pressure.
The beam of his light illuminated a colossal statue carved from an unknown mineral—a monstrous figure with writhing tentacles: the "Arbiter of Silence" foretold by ancient star charts.
Countless geometric glyphs etched into the pedestal. The scan device spat out a precise sequence—matching the prehistoric organisms that once underwent an evolutionary explosion on distant Earth.
On his chest, the indicator blinked green.
UNANALYZABLE SIGNAL DETECTED—DATA UPLOAD IN PROGRESS
A thread of light ran across the statue’s surface, locking onto Elias. The wordless harvest had quietly begun.

Haste.text:
Make haste, lest we lack the breath for speech.
Toll the bell and call back forgotten days.
To the Forge-God, his scion, and his bloodline,
Where every smile dissolves in quiet hill.
